retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: Vink deletes a Document's file, what it read and its values once they're no longer needed. The Document's name, dates, history and Delivery log stay.
retention.saved: Saved. It applies from the next daily cleanup.
retention.daysHint: 1 to 365. Counted from the last successful Delivery, from Approval when nothing is sent, or from the last attempt when every Delivery failed.
retention.neverApproved: Documents never approved: 90 days after upload.
retention.rejected: Rejected Documents: 30 days after Reject. They can't be reopened after that.
retention.proposals: Unsaved Form Proposals: 7 days, with their sample.

items.title: Items
items.description: A PDF page, an email's text and a photo each count as one item. You pay once, when it's uploaded. A cover note for attachments and small signature images are free. Retries and moving a Document to another Form are free.
items.noneFree: Free items come once, with the first Organisation someone creates. This Organisation has none, so choose a Plan to upload.

billing.chooseDescription: Every Plan includes everything. You only choose how many items. Prices excl. VAT.
billing.custom: More than 3,000 items a month, or payment by invoice? <contact>Talk to us</contact>.
billing.subscribed: Payment received. Your Plan is ready in a moment.
billing.toppedUp: Payment received. Your extra items are added in a moment.
billing.failed: Couldn't open the payment page. Try again.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Let a program use Vink without a user: list Forms, send in Documents, read approved data. Read the <link>API reference</link>.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.newDescription: Name it after the program that uses it, so you know which one to revoke later.
apiKeys.notMade: The key wasn't made. Try again.
apiKeys.madeDescription: Copy the key and put it in your program. Send it in the Authorization: Bearer header, followed by a space and the key.
apiKeys.notCopied: Couldn't copy. Select the key and copy it by hand.
apiKeys.onlyOnce: You see this key only now. Vink keeps only a fingerprint of it, so it can't show it again. Lost it? Make a new one and revoke this one.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Programs that use this key get an error from their next request on. Your other keys keep working.
apiKeys.notRevoked: The key wasn't revoked. Try again.

dangerZone.title: Danger Zone
dangerZone.description: Deleting happens at once. You can't undo it.

organisation.title: Delete Organisation
organisation.row: Deletes {name} and everything in it: documents, forms, integrations, API Keys and members.
organisation.body: Everything in {name} is deleted at once: documents and files, forms, integrations, API Keys, invitations and members. Nobody can open the Organisation after that.
organisation.plan: A running plan stops at once. You get no refund. Your invoices stay available at Stripe.
organisation.failed: The Organisation was not deleted. Try again.

account.title: Delete account
account.row: Deletes your own account and sign-in details. Organisations where you are the only member go with it.
account.body: Your account is deleted at once. After that you can't sign in with {email}.
account.alsoDeleted: These Organisations have no other members. They are deleted too, with everything in them. A running plan stops at once, without a refund:
account.blocked: You are the last Admin of these Organisations. First make someone else Admin under Members, or delete the Organisation:
account.failed: Your account was not deleted. Try again.
